capabilities.name: Manual CPR
capabilities.note: In lunar and Mars gravity compressions often fall short of guideline depth, more so for lighter rescuers; rotate rescuers in under 1 minute

source.doc: Overbeek R, et al. Effectiveness of CPR in Hypogravity Conditions: A Systematic Review. Life (Basel) 2022;12(12):1958

capabilities.name: Gravity-fed IV drip
capabilities.note: Some gravity to drive flow, but slower than on Earth; a pressure infuser may still be needed

capabilities.name: Major surgery (e.g. appendectomy)
capabilities.note: Outside the exploration treatment scope in the IMM CLiFFs

source.doc: IMM CLiFF ICL8 Appendicitis (2023), Capability Resource Table overview

capabilities.name: CT or X-ray imaging
capabilities.note: CT 'will likely not be available' per the IMM CLiFFs

source.doc: IMM CLiFF ICL8 Appendicitis (2023), Capability Resource Table overview

capabilities.name: Blood tests (CBC with differential, metabolic panel)
capabilities.note: Not in the IMM kit lists; the 2023 CLiFFs assume these will be possible on exploration missions

source.doc: IMM CLiFF ICL8 Appendicitis (2023), Capability Resource Table overview

capabilities.note: No blood products in any IMM kit list

notes: Early Artemis: two crew descend for about a week on the surface (Ruttley 2021). Assigning the IMM 7.5-day kit to the lander is our assumption; the IMM paired it with the Orion kit.
